finding: InertialUnit yaw decreases for a positive omega command, so the device yaw is clockwise-positive while the controller heading convention is counter-clockwise-positive; the sign must be reconciled before the heading loop can close.
note: A 4-wheel rectangular skid-steer was previously blamed for the stall; this run shows the chassis pivots cleanly, so that earlier diagnosis is withdrawn.
purpose: isolate the pivot capability of the two-wheel differential model: command omega=+0.8 rad/s with v=0 and measure the sign of the resulting yaw rate
